=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28705-28754 (cache store/lookup 293-310, 2831-2849) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The standalone-stall mergeability retry loop calls `_fetch_pr_json` up to 5 times with only 5/10/15/20s sleeps, and `_orch_poll_pr_json_cache_store` caches the first unsettled payload (`mergeable:null` / `mergeable_state:"unknown"`), so every later attempt inside the 60s ORCH_POLL_PR_JSON_CACHE_TTL_SECS gets that same cached payload.
  WHY: The loop never sees the settled state, wastes about 50s per stalled PR, and fails open into the legacy retrigger_review empty-commit push (lines 29224-29226), bringing back the PR #1375/#1380 loop and changing a poller decision, which the issue forbids. All reviewers rated it BLOCKER (mapped to critical).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11805-11846 (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2262-2284) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: update_eager_pr_validation_status_section sends its PR-body PATCH through `gh_retry_to_file`, which never runs GH_RETRY_AFTER_CALL_HOOK, and no `_invalidate_pr_json_cache` follows a successful PATCH, so later `_fetch_pr_json` reads (e.g. ~15992) get the pre-PATCH `.body`.
  WHY: The stale body makes later calls send redundant PATCHes until the TTL expires, which adds API calls and breaks the agents.d/9927 contract; test_unwrapped_pr_writes_followed_by_invalidation does not scan this form. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax, z-ai) vs NIT (sonnet); the highest was used (high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13045-13049 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_integration_judge_commit_and_push` pushes the final PR's head branch with `git -C "${wt}" ... push` and does not call `_invalidate_pr_json_cache`; the test write_re regex cannot match the continuation-line form, so the test still passes. z-ai also cites 35610-35612 and 35674-35676 (RB pushes); sonnet says a following gh_retry write already covers those.
  WHY: Final-PR reads later in the same tick (~14721, 15742, 15931, 16111) can get the pre-push head.sha/mergeable state for up to 60s, so head-bound merge gates fail needlessly or decisions use stale state. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (minimax, luna, z-ai) vs NIT (sonnet); the highest was used (high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:424-450 (_review_run_default_branch 30331-30388; failure memo 30369-30373) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_orch_poll_default_branch_or_live` sends the 17 generic default-branch sites through `_review_run_default_branch`, whose transient first-GET failure is saved as `failed`; the memo stays `failed` even when the wrapper's fallback live GET then succeeds.
  WHY: For the rest of the poll, every PR-named review-run provenance matcher fails closed (warning at 30373) even though the default branch was resolved. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (luna) vs NIT (sonnet); the highest was used (high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:437-449 (_review_run_default_branch GET 30361-30373) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the memoized lookup fails, the wrapper makes a second live `gh_retry` GET for the same repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY} endpoint (446/448) and does not check the memo's `failed` sentinel.
  WHY: The failure path, including rate-limit exhaustion, pays two full gh_retry attempt sequences, against the issue's "Each change must strictly reduce calls". Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax) vs NIT (luna, z-ai, sonnet); the highest was used (high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:343-395 (_invalidate_pr_json_cache 315-336) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_orch_poll_pr_json_cache_after_gh_call` treats every non-read gh_retry call as a write, including issue-only `gh issue edit` label swaps, comment POSTs, ensure_label_exists and `gh workflow run` (e.g. 33193), and each one flushes the whole PR JSON cache and rotates the gen token.
  WHY: The cache over-invalidates. That is never stale, but it wipes PR entries on almost every loop iteration and removes most of the intended savings behind the 25% target. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax, luna) vs NIT (sonnet, z-ai); the highest was used (high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:428-443 (vs _review_run_default_branch 30334-30359, regex at 30348) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The wrapper sets `_odbl_cached=true` for any memo line starting with "ok " without the function's branch-name regex check, so a corrupted or rejected memo value still counts a default_branch hit after a fresh live GET.
  WHY: cache_hits_default_branch is inflated by one for that cycle; this affects observability only, not decisions.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:247-309 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_orch_poll_pr_json_cache_store` reads the gen token twice (lines 298 and 303) between mktemp and rename, so a concurrent `_invalidate_pr_json_cache` can publish an entry stamped with a stale gen.
  WHY: Concurrent subshells can race the gen-token rotation. That is benign for correctness (a miss falls back to a live GET) but lowers the hit rate. z-ai separately judged the gen-token design sound.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:378 (init gate 397-415) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `_gh_api_args_unsafe_post` is undefined, `_orch_poll_pr_json_cache_gh_call_is_read` returns 1 (write), so every gh_retry call flushes the cache; a caller that sets GH_RETRY_AFTER_CALL_HOOK outside the init gates lands here with no diagnostic.
  WHY: The cache looks initialized but never hits (cache_hits_pr_json=0), and the hook's discarded output hides the misclassification.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2149-2160 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: GH_RETRY_AFTER_CALL_HOOK is not namespaced to the poller, so any script that sources gh_helpers.sh and inherits the env var runs `_orch_poll_pr_json_cache_after_gh_call` on its own gh_retry calls.
  WHY: The hook changes the filesystem (removes cache files, moves the gen token), so callers with different ORCH_POLL_PR_JSON_CACHE_DIR paths can rotate each other's tokens. z-ai separately judged this surface safe.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk touches the noop sweep's comment reads, no dedup test exists in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, the deferral appears only in the PR's own `ai:partial-delivery` marker and changelog (Gate B fail-closed snapshot) and not in the issue, and the issue's suggested approach (reuse the first snapshot and append the posted comment) was not tried
- requirement: "Measurable outcome: at least a 25% drop in the poller's REST calls per run for the same state, measured with #9887's calls_in_job before and after on comparable cycles."
  expected_change_site: #9927 acceptance evidence / PR description or poller call-count validation
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

- requirement: "_fetch_pr_json: Serve repeat reads of the same repo#number within one poll cycle from a cycle-local cache" — "The same review-blocked PR is read 4-6x per cycle"
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the review-blocked path (_rb_pr_json at 34294 and the re-reads at 34715, 35311, 35383, 35436, 35726, 35799)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: All six RB re-fetch sites (_rb_pr_json_refetched, _rb_merge_json, _rb_fm_json, _rb_recheck_json, _rb_nofix_json, _rb_mwf_json) call `_invalidate_pr_json_cache "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${RB_PR}"` right before `_fetch_pr_json` (pinned by test_rb_fresh_read_sites_invalidate_before_fetch), so the RB path still makes the same number of live GETs. The issue only required invalidate-on-write and accepted the risk of external-change staleness, and no call-count evidence offsets the lost savings

  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_cycle_summary.py
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The pre-push gate lists tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py as Unverified (timeout) and every acceptance row as "not run"; shellcheck is reported as a failure caused by this change, but the head-SHA check-runs show 0 failed (ci.yml:654 runs `--severity=error`), so the shellcheck result is unconfirmed
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:run_standalone_stall_recovery, mergeability retry loop at lines 28721-28754; _fetch_pr_json (line 2831), _orch_poll_pr_json_cache_store (line 293) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cache stores an open PR with `mergeable:null` / `mergeable_state:"unknown"`. The loop sleeps (5/10/15/20s, about 50s) make no gh_retry write, so every attempt inside the 60s TTL gets the same unsettled payload, and the line 28614 read may already have seeded it.
  WHY: The loop never sees the settled state, burns about 50s, and fails open into retrigger_review (git push at line 29226), the PR #1375/#1380 loop, which changes a poller decision. Fix: do not store unsettled open PRs, or invalidate before line 28722; the same rule protects the final-merge reads at 15742, 15931, 15992, 16111.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:update_eager_pr_validation_status_section, lines 11805 and 11837-11846; gh_retry_to_file at scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2262 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PATCH goes through gh_retry_to_file (no GH_RETRY_AFTER_CALL_HOOK) with no invalidation afterwards, so the line 15992 `_fetch_pr_json` hits a stale `.body`; the test does not scan this form, and the agents.d claim is false here.
  WHY: A second call in the same tick sends a redundant PATCH, which is a new API call. Fix: add `_invalidate_pr_json_cache` after the PATCH.
